_comment: Placeholder/debt ratchet baselines (see docs/RULES.md 4.4 and
docs/GUIDELINES.md). Counts must EQUAL the current tree: higher is a
regression, lower means the baseline goes down in the same PR. A raise
is a policy change and needs explicit review.
Add your own patterns (e.g. raw-address debt, magic numbers) the day
you introduce them — ratchets go up the day the first placeholder appears.
unknown_function 0->1 (2026-10-10): first C match, src/func_80036CFC.c,
matched but the original symbol name is still unidentified.
unknown_function 1->3 (2026-10-10): two more C matches through the
round-trip oracle (slps_00270 gp-store leaves), auto names retained —
one mention per file per the counting rule.
unknown_data 0->4 (2026-10-10): extern declarations + uses of the two
small-data globals those matches write (2 mentions per file: extern
plus store). Names are spimdisasm address names; no Psy-Q headers exist
to give them real identities yet.

unknown_function 3->14 (2026-10-11): first real compiler-output C match through the round-trip oracle - the g3_eu wrapper cluster (4 short-arg void wrappers over the palette-fade helper). 14 = 3 prior stub files + 4 auto-named definitions (real symbol names unidentified) + 1 extern declaration + 6 call sites of the still-asm callee. Auto names retained; rename when the helper's identity is evidenced.

unknown_function 14->20 (2026-10-11): sequence-reset wrapper matched (g3_eu, yaml entry split asm->c at 0x2DF04). 20 = 14 + 1 auto-named definition + 2 extern declarations (the reset helper, first reference anywhere; the palette-fade helper already externed per-file rule) + 3 call sites. The div-guard block after it stays asm on evidence: its final j leaves the frame allocated with $ra never reloaded - not C tail-call codegen.

unknown_function 20->23 (2026-10-11): three trivial functions matched across three targets (first C functions for g3_jp, mainmenu_jp; g3_eu second): two empty void bodies (g3_jp 0x800629A0, g3_eu 0x80062280) and one return-4th-arg getter (mainmenu_jp 0x800791A4). 23 = 20 + 3 auto-named definitions, no externs (no callees). The getter needed a third cc_post rule: cc1 fills the return jump's delay slot with the value move, retail keeps it before the jump with a nop delay slot.

unknown_function 23->85, unknown_data 4->8 (2026-10-11): mainmenu_eu wrapper family matched through the round-trip oracle - the whole 0x2c8 cluster at 0x800379E4 as one C unit (16 void wrappers over the menu-state flag D_800C936C, the sequence helper func_80035664 and the menu primitive func_80025CFC; first C functions for mainmenu_eu). 85 = 23 + 16 definitions + 2 extern declarations + 31 call sites (16+15) + 11 comment references; 8 = 4 + 1 extern + 2 stores + 1 comment mention. cc_post gained rule 4 (prologue save restore) and build.sh gained -G0 + gp_value-gated gp_rel rewrite (bare-symbol externs now expand to retail's absolute lui/$at form on non-gp targets). Three scanned head/tail pairs (B40+B60, B6C+B7C, B98+BA4) are whole C functions; their mid-function entry labels resolve by address via the two-pass auto-definition.

unknown_function 85->226, unknown_data 8->12 (2026-10-11): mainmenu_jp wrapper family matched through the round-trip oracle - the whole 0x6b8 cluster at 0x80037A44 as one C unit (35 void wrappers, the JP twin of the mainmenu_eu family; JP carries 19 more variants incl. multi-sequence (7,M) runs and the stateful func_8003800C snapshotting func_80035A78(0)). 226 = 85 + 35 definitions + 3 extern declarations + 83 call sites (35+47+1) + 20 comment references; 12 = 8 + 1 extern + 2 stores + 1 comment. cc_post gained rule 5 (prologue call delay normalization) and rule 1 grew the two-load epilogue variant (5->4, nop absorbed): both found on func_8003800C, the first two-save frame. Three scanned pieces (BA0+BBC, BCC+BD8, BF8+C00) are whole C functions; their mid-function entry labels (func_80037BBC/func_80037BD8 jump targets, func_80037D2C shared entry) resolve by address via the two-pass auto-definition.

unknown_function 226->317 (2026-10-11): mainmenu_eu wrapper variants 17-35 matched through the round-trip oracle - the 19 twins hiding in the carved data_80037CAC (JP func_80037D0C..func_800380D0, EU = JP - 0x60, 52 differing words all jal targets), ported verbatim from src/func_80037A44.c with renamed callees as src/func_80037CAC.c. 317 = 226 + 88 tokens in the new file (19 definitions + 3 extern declarations + 55 call sites + 11 comment references) + 3 comment tokens added to src/func_80037A44.c correcting the obsolete 'JP-only variants' note. build.sh's two-pass auto-definition gained the .L<8hex> address-label form (func_8003B568's j .L80037CB0 into the C-matched body; maspsx promotes the label, the definer must too). Progress 62->81 matched functions across targets (8.72%).
